title: Principles And Practice Of Insurance
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a personal retirement account in which the earnings are based on a fixed rate set by the insurance company."
A fixed annuity is a personal retirement account in which the earnings are based on a fixed rate set by the insurance company.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the right of one person to stand in the place of another and avail himself of all the rights and remedies of that other party whether already enforced or not."
Subrogation is the right of one person to stand in the place of another and avail himself of all the rights and remedies of that other party whether already enforced or not.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important factor in underwriting motor insurance, theft insurance and all risks insurance."
Proposer's address is an important factor in underwriting motor insurance, theft insurance and all risks insurance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a personal retirement account in which the investment grows tax-deferred until the investor is ready to withdraw the assets."
A variable annuity is a personal retirement account in which the investment grows tax-deferred until the investor is ready to withdraw the assets.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used, the effect is the same as any offer."
Whichever wording is used, the effect is the same as any offer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the letter's agreement of those terms."
Acceptance refers to the letter's agreement of those terms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used as a means of obtaining relatively inexpensive cover and to cover the event of early death over lengthy periods."
Whole life assurance is used as a means of obtaining relatively inexpensive cover and to cover the event of early death over lengthy periods.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are considered in determining the claim costs depending on the class of insurance under consideration."
Various factors are considered in determining the claim costs depending on the class of insurance under consideration.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as a positive duty to voluntarily disclose, accurately and fully, all facts materials to the risk being proposed, whether asked for them or not."
Utmost good faith (uberrimae fidei) can be defined as a positive duty to voluntarily disclose, accurately and fully, all facts materials to the risk being proposed, whether asked for them or not.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person who acts on behalf of another."
Insurance Agents - An agent is a person who acts on behalf of another.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are concerned with the attitudes and conduct of people."
Moral hazards are concerned with the attitudes and conduct of people.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known as a renewal notice."
The invitation is known as a renewal notice.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first principle of insurance."
Insurable interest is the first principle of insurance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the insurance of ships, crew, passengers and cargoes exposed to marine perils."
Marine Cargo of Hall Insurance is the insurance of ships, crew, passengers and cargoes exposed to marine perils.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a waste to the economy and the need to restore the loss with minimal delay underscores the need to have fire insurance protection."
Fire loss or damage is a waste to the economy and the need to restore the loss with minimal delay underscores the need to have fire insurance protection.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a communication of the contract terms by one party to another."
An offer is a communication of the contract terms by one party to another.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a financial contract written by an insurance company that provides for a series of guaranteed payments, either for a specific period of time or for the lifetime of one or more individuals."

An annuity is a financial contract written by an insurance company that provides for a series of guaranteed payments, either for a specific period of time or for the lifetime of one or more individuals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a coronary of the principle of indemnity."
The principle of subrogation is a coronary of the principle of indemnity.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a contract between the policy owner and the insurer, where the insurer agrees to pay a sum of money upon the occurrence of the insured's death."
Life insurance or life assurance is a contract between the policy owner and the insurer, where the insurer agrees to pay a sum of money upon the occurrence of the insured's death.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the first document a buyer of insurance will be required to complete."
The proposal form is the first document a buyer of insurance will be required to complete.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the rights (or the exercise of the rights) of an insurer to call upon other insurers similarly (though not necessarily equally) liable to the same insured to share the cost of an indemnity payment."

Contribution can be defined as the rights (or the exercise of the rights) of an insurer to call upon other insurers similarly (though not necessarily equally) liable to the same insured to share the cost of an indemnity payment.
fib: ______ means that all parties to the contract of insurance must disclose all material information.
Utmost good faith (uberrima fidei)
Utmost good faith
Utmost good faith (uberrima fidei) means that all parties to the contract of insurance must disclose all material information.
______ refers to the insurance cover on vessels, fishing trawlers, motor boats and other outboard engines.
Hull insurance
Hull insurance refers to the insurance cover on vessels, fishing trawlers, motor boats and other outboard engines.
______ is an agreement between an insurance company and the individual effecting the insurance cover.
insurance contract
An insurance contract is an agreement between an insurance company and the individual effecting the insurance cover.
______ is a reminder to the insured that his existing insurance cover is about to expire.
renewal notice
A renewal notice is a reminder to the insured that his existing insurance cover is about to expire.
______ is a financial compensation provided by insurers in an attempt to place the insured in the same pecuniary position after the loss as he enjoyed immediately before the loss.
Indemnity
Indemnity is a financial compensation provided by insurers in an attempt to place the insured in the same pecuniary position after the loss as he enjoyed immediately before the loss.
______ is a factual statement made by one party to the other which is intended and succeeds in persuading the latter to enter into the contract.
representation
A representation is a factual statement made by one party to the other which is intended and succeeds in persuading the latter to enter into the contract.
______ is the amount an insurer would have to pay if he was the only insurer covering the loss.
Independent liability
Independent liability is the amount an insurer would have to pay if he was the only insurer covering the loss.
______ is a life assurance contract designed to pay a lump sum after a specified term (on its "maturity") or on earlier death.
endowment policy
An endowment policy is a life assurance contract designed to pay a lump sum after a specified term (on its "maturity") or on earlier death.
______ is a temporary policy of insurance.
cover note
A cover note is a temporary policy of insurance.
______ are used in the process of insurance policy renewal.
Certain documents
Certain documents are used in the process of insurance policy renewal.
______ is an agreement between two or more participants which is legally binding.
contract
A contract is an agreement between two or more participants which is legally binding.
______ is the unlooked for, unwanted event in the future.
Risk
Risk is the unlooked for, unwanted event in the future.
______ is the evidence of a contract of insurance.
policy document
The policy document is the evidence of a contract of insurance.
______ is an "ALL RISKS" against all sudden and unforeseen loss or damage occurring to the property during the period of insurance.
cover
The cover is an "ALL RISKS" against all sudden and unforeseen loss or damage occurring to the property during the period of insurance.
______ is the construction period plus the maintenance period.
period of cover
The period of cover is the construction period plus the maintenance period.
______ is the insurance of ships, crew, passengers and cargoes exposed to maritime perils.
Marine Insurance
Marine Insurance is the insurance of ships, crew, passengers and cargoes exposed to maritime perils.
______ refers to the gain or benefit received by one party in return for a promise or the performance of an act of another.
Consideration
Consideration refers to the gain or benefit received by one party in return for a promise or the performance of an act of another.
______ is the amount which is added to the premium to cover expected divided payments to the shareholders.
profit loading
The profit loading - The profit loading is the amount which is added to the premium to cover expected divided payments to the shareholders.
______ are a mixture of traditional whole life and universal life.
policies
The policies are a mixture of traditional whole life and universal life.
______ is an arrangement by which one party promises to pay another party a sum of money if some thing should happen which causes the insured party to suffer financial loss.
Insurance
Insurance is an arrangement by which one party promises to pay another party a sum of money if some thing should happen which causes the insured party to suffer financial loss.
______ are those contracts funded with after-tax funds.
Non-qualified annuities
Non-qualified annuities are those contracts funded with after-tax funds.
